0022600177.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-6, on a five-game losing streak) visit the New York Knicks (3-4, on a one-game winning streak) in the Bulls' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Chicago is 15th in the East and fifth in the Central, five games back, with a 0-2 home record and a 1-4 road record, while New York is eighth in the East and fourth in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, with a 2-2 home record and a 1-2 road record. The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 133-127 in Chicago, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3; Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury.
